about: Stages for the monthly-hygiene playbook. scripts/handoff.py reads this file: the stages it tracks and the outcomes each stage can record. No stage waits for another: the whole sweep can run in one session. Each stage names the product it needs, so a run with only one product is offered the other product's stages as skips. Each key is explained under notes.

stages.name: rule-audit
stages.do: Audit every Discovery merchandising rule and add the ranking and facet rules to clean up as findings.

stages.name: rule-cleanup
stages.do: Build one cleanup plan for the user to review from the findings they approve, then write it batch by batch, each after its own yes, with each delete on its own.

skip_when.reason: the rule audit found nothing to clean up.
the rule audit was skipped this month.

stages.name: redirect-audit
stages.do: Audit every search redirect and add the fixes as findings.

stages.name: redirect-fix
stages.do: Build one redirect plan for the user to review from the fixes they approve, then write it batch by batch, each after its own yes, with each switch-on and delete on its own.

skip_when.reason: the redirect audit found nothing to fix.
the redirect audit was skipped this month.

stages.name: asset-cleanup
stages.do: List the Engagement project's stale drafts, test copies and unused definitions, and add the delete and archive candidates as findings.

stages.name: dependency-map
stages.do: Map what depends on each candidate and give the user a safe deletion order to act on in the Engagement UI. Nothing is deleted here.

skip_when.reason: the asset cleanup found no candidates.
the asset cleanup was skipped this month.

notes.playbooks: Each playbook's title, product and stages in order. A stage names the skill that does it, whether that skill writes, what to do, the outcomes it can record, not_before (wait this rules key's number of days after another stage is done) and skip_when (suggest skipping when another stage had one of these outcomes).
notes.max_chosen: How many findings can be chosen at once. Each write stage plans every finding the user approves together, up to this many; the rest wait for next month.
